name: Effective Range / Projected Distinguishing Range
details: Every projection has effective range contained in that of the original class.
proof: For every projection $\mathcal H_{|S}$, any distinguishing coordinate set can be chosen inside its effective range, so $\mathrm R(\mathcal H_{|S})\leq\mathrm E(\mathcal H_{|S})\leq\mathrm E(\mathcal H)$. Maximizing over S proves the claimed bound.
witness_verification: For the two trivial concepts on n coordinates, $\mathrm E=n$ while every nonempty projection has distinguishing range one, so $\mathrm R^p=1$. Hence the gap is unbounded.
